tasks.title: Address translation simulator
tasks.statement: Compare shadow page tables and nested EPT/NPT on four workloads. Change the mode and the guest and host page sizes, and watch the two-dimensional walk on a TLB miss and the total cost in memory accesses. The exercise is solved when all four goals are met.
tasks.hint: A TLB entry covers a page of the smaller of the two sizes: a guest huge page is useless if the host pages are small.

spec_text./workloads/0/note: one memory access: look at the cost of the walk
spec_text./workloads/1/note: 2048 consecutive accesses with a 4 KiB stride
spec_text./workloads/3/note: 500 mapping changes by the guest and 2000 random accesses over 1 GiB
spec_text./goals/0/text: A single miss costs at most 15 accesses (nested tables)
spec_text./goals/1/text: Scanning 8 MiB in 4 KiB pages is cheaper than in EPT: at most 15,000
spec_text./goals/2/text: Random accesses over 64 MiB fit in 10,000 accesses
spec_text./goals/3/text: Frequent page table changes: at most 35,000 accesses
